events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov scored 27 seconds into overtime to give the Tampa Bay Lightning a 4-3 victory against the Detroit Red Wings on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikita Kucherov scores 27 seconds into OT to give the Lightning a 4-3 victory against the Red Wings

events.name: New York Rangers at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Cole Reinhardt scored his second goal of the game with 1:50 remaining and spoiled New York goaltender Jonathan Quick's final NHL game as the Florida Panthers beat the Rangers 3-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reinhardt's 2nd goal leads Panthers past the Rangers 3-2, spoils Jonathan Quick's last game in net

headlines.description: — Tyson Foerster scored the only goal in the shootout to send the Philadelphia Flyers to a 3-2 win over the Eastern Conference top seed Carolina Hurricanes on Monday night and into the playoffs for the first time since 2020.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flyers beat East top seed Hurricanes 3-2 in SO and secure their first playoff berth since 2020

events.name: Dallas Stars at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Mavrik Bourque had his first NHL hat trick and added an assist as the Dallas Stars rallied from a pair of deficits and beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 6-5 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bourque's 4-point game helps the Stars rally past the Maple Leafs 6-5

events.name: Minnesota Wild at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Theo Lindstein scored and the St. Louis Blues overcame a two-goal deficit and beat the Minnesota Wild 6-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blues rally from a 2-goal deficit and beat the Wild 6-3

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini scored twice in the third period, including an empty-netter with 1:45 remaining, to reach 44 goals on the season and the San Jose Sharks beat the Nashville Predators 3-2 on Monday night to end a 15-game losing streak in the series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini scores 2 goals in the 3rd period to lift the Sharks past the Predators 3-2

headlines.description: — Tage Thompson scored twice to reach 40 goals on the season, and the Buffalo Sabres clinched the Atlantic Division title by defeating the Chicago Blackhawks 5-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thompson stars as Sabres clinch Atlantic title with a 5-1 victory over Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored the decisive goal in a shootout and the Colorado Avalanche beat the Edmonton Oilers 2-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan MacKinnon scores in shootout as Avalanche top Oilers 2-1

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Quinton Byfield scored twice, Anton Forsberg made 28 saves and the Los Angeles Kings secured a playoff spot with Monday night's 5-3 win over the Seattle Kraken.
headlines.shortLinkText: Quinton Byfield scores twice and Kings secure playoff spot with 5-3 win over Kraken

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Mark Stone scored his fourth goal in three games and combined with Jack Eichel for seven points as the Golden Knights defeated the Winnipeg Jets 6-2 on Monday night to move Vegas closer to winning a fifth Pacific Division title in its nine seasons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eichel and Stone lead Golden Knights to 6-2 win over Jets and close in on Pacific Division title
